brief_text: Use gravity 9.81 m/s2, contact friction 0.72, restitution 0.04, hinge damping 0.04 N m s/rad, and slide damping 0.20 N s/m; start every body from rest. Ball1 starts 0.30 m above ring1 and drops vertically through it. Ball1 falls another 0.25 m and touches the left end of lever1, a 0.60 by 0.10 by 0.04 m, 0.50 kg center-hinged lever. Lever1 rotates clockwise through 45 degrees to its lower stop, and its rising right end knocks cart1 along a horizontal slide. Cart1 slides 0.42 m and touches domino1.
